resources.string: Plays the new-message effect over the lock screen and hides the system bars while the LED turns the screen on.

When a new message lights the lock screen, this service draws your chosen glow effect over it for two seconds; the lock screen stays visible and usable underneath. When the LED lights the screen, it also covers the battery icon and navigation handle with black for half a second. It reads no screen content and receives no accessibility events.
Briefly used to light the screen when a message arrives. Dismissed automatically.
What plays the moment a message arrives, in the app\'s colour.
Afterwards the screen goes black and only this dot blinks, one blink per waiting app, until you read or dismiss the messages.
A wave of light bursts out of the camera and lights the glow as it passes.
A ring of fire bursts from the camera and sweeps the screen, setting the glow alight as it passes.
The wave rolls in like water over glass: a soft, shimmering crest of light with a gentle ripple behind it. Clear as glass, it always glows in the colour of the app that sent the message.
The camera lets out a gust that sweeps the screen in curling lines of wind, setting the glow alight as it passes.
The camera strikes the ground: a shock runs out of it and the screen breaks open in light and stone, setting the glow alight as it passes.
Your premium trial is over: new messages arrive as Water until you unlock it.
The days count from the first message it plays for. Previews here are always free.
Three more elements for the wave and the Edge Frame, each with options of its own. New elements are included as they come.
Your own colour for any app
Pick the colour each app glows in, on the effect and on the LED.
No subscription. Google Play takes the payment, so Ambient Glow itself still never goes online.
Always free: the LED, every screen choice, LED Beacon and Edge Frame, Water, and which apps light up, with look-alikes kept apart.
Google Play can\'t sell premium right now. Check that the Play Store is installed and signed in, then come back.
Premium is yours. Thank you for supporting Ambient Glow.
New messages arrive as Water again, and every app glows in its icon\'s colour. Your choices are kept: unlock premium once and they\'re back for good.
Coming soon: it plays as the bare wave for now.
With Just the LED, new messages skip the effect and go straight to the dot. Pick a screen that plays an effect to style it here.
The lock screen lights up frosted and the wave sweeps it clear, so your notifications swim out sharp behind it.
A frosted band rides under the crest: whatever it passes goes soft, then sharp again.
The whole screen frosts over as the wave rolls in, then clears as it leaves.
Needs Android 12+. Where the blur can\'t follow the wave, the whole screen blurs.
On a black screen there is nothing to blur: frost shows only where the wave\'s light catches it.
Real fire: white-hot at the front, then yellow, orange and deep red. The same for every app.
The flames burn in the colour of the app that sent the message, white-hot at the front.
Real fire whose tips take the app\'s colour, the way metal salts colour a flame.
The lock screen lights up dark as char and the fire burns it open, like a sheet of paper, so your notifications appear behind the flames.
The ground the fire crossed glows on in cracks, like cooling coals, then fades.
Only the wall of flame: the screen behind it is left as it was.
On a black screen there is no char to see: only embers smoulder at the fire\'s edge.
Straight lines rush out of the camera, like speed lines in a comic.
Lines sweep out and curl at their tips, the way animation draws the wind.
The whole gust turns as it spreads, its lines spiralling out like a whirlwind.
Clear air: white lines with a pale sky-blue glow. The same for every app.
The wind blows in the colour of the app that sent the message, white at the tip of every line.
White wind trailing the colour of the app that sent the message.
The gust drags the screen it passes over out in streaks along its wind, then lets it snap back sharp behind it.
The screen under the gust stays sharp.
The screen splits in a web of cracks with light pouring out of them. Nothing covers your notifications.
The ground breaks into plates of stone that heave up between glowing cracks, then crumble away behind the shock.
Jagged spires of rock burst up and out behind the shock, the way earth is bent in anime, then sink back into the ground.
Grey stone with golden light in its cracks, like pottery mended with gold. The same for every app.
Stone tinged with the colour of the app that sent the message, its cracks glowing in it.
The ground breaks open into crystal in the colour of the app that sent the message, the way a geode does.
Turn on Ambient Glow effects to play the effect over the lock screen. Without it the lock screen only lights up.
Preview of a new message: the effect, then the LED. Tap to replay.
Every change plays once at full size on this screen. Messages glow in the colour of the app that sent them.
Animations are off on this phone, so changes play only in the preview, once. Tap it to replay. Messages glow in the colour of the app that sent them.
The lock screen lights up with all your notifications and the effect plays over it.
The screen comes on black and plays only the effect.
No effect: the screen comes on black and only the LED dot lights. The least battery of all.
Black screen, the effect, and a pop-up of only the new message. Your lock-screen privacy settings decide how much shows.

Plays your effect over the lock screen when a message arrives; without it the lock screen only lights up. Android files this under accessibility and warns about full control: Ambient Glow reads nothing on screen.
In Settings, open Installed apps (or Downloaded apps), tap Ambient Glow effects and turn it on.
Ambient Glow now lights up for new messages. Next, choose what that looks like, then tap the padlock at the top to try it on the locked phone.
Ambient Glow now lights up for new messages. You can turn on lock-screen effects any time from the Screen tab.
Lets Ambient Glow notice new messages and pick each app\'s colour. Android will warn that it could read your notifications: it never reads, stores or sends what they say.
Android only lets an app turn the screen on through an alert. This one is silent and closes itself at once: you won\'t see or hear it.
Android 14+ asks you to confirm that Ambient Glow may turn the display on.
Android says \"Restricted setting\"? Open App info, tap ⋮ in the top corner, choose Allow restricted settings, then come back and try again.
Lights up right where your LED waits, then becomes it.
Light runs round the edge of the screen, then flies into your LED.
Only these pixels light up. Drag the dot or tap where it should go; it snaps to the spots below and the ruler marks. The real LED shows on this screen as you change it.
The LED Beacon lights up here when a message arrives.
Line the ring up with your camera lens. It lights on screen while you tap.
Dot position preview. Drag to move.
Every app that sends you a message shows up here, in the colour it glows in. Switch off the ones you don\'t need to see.
Tap an app to change its colour; the LED shows each pick on this screen. New apps light up until you switch them off.
Apps show up here the first time they send you a message, and light up until you switch them off. To switch one off before it does, find it under Other apps.

A line of light, in the colours you pick below. Its last spark flies to your LED.
A burning fuse: white-hot where the light runs, cooling to embers behind it, with flames licking in off the edge. Its last ember flies to your LED, which smoulders on as a live coal.

Liquid light in a glass tube: it ripples, swells into a wave where the light runs, and glints along its surface. A last drop falls into your LED, which waits as a bead of water and ripples as it blinks.
A slipstream: no solid line, only wind racing round the edge, carrying what the gust picks up. A last wisp curls into your LED, which keeps turning as a curl of air.
A crack mended in light: the edge splits open, cracks branch in as it lights, and a sheen runs along the seam. The light closes into a gem that becomes your LED and glints as it blinks.
